title: Scalar Tuned Lens Summaries Offer Limited Incremental Value for Mid-Generation Abstention
abstract: arXiv:2611.29589v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mid-generation abstention aims to stop an unpromising response before spending its remaining computation budget. Intermediate transformer states may help predict eventual correctness, but whether scalar summaries of their vocabulary predictions add useful evidence is less clear. We compare Tuned Lens entropy and divergence features with final-state and raw intermediate-state probes under matched, causal evaluation. Across eight instruction-tuned models on MATH-500, raw intermediate states improve ranking, whereas scalar-only probes usually trail the final-state baseline. Scalar hybrids have positive exceptions, but their advantage over position-matched permutation controls is small. Cross-fitted residual comparisons further show that gains over a final-state probe need not require aligned scalar features. Actual stopping runs on two model sizes and two benchmarks reveal a separate accuracy--computation trade-off, with token savings overs

translated_title: 标量Tuned Lens（调整透镜）摘要特征对生成中途弃答的增量价值有限
translated_abstract: 生成中途弃答旨在在消耗剩余计算预算之前，提前停止没有前景的回答。Transformer的中间状态可能有助于预测最终答案的正确性，但其词表预测的标量摘要能否提供有用证据尚不明确。我们在匹配的因果评估条件下，将Tuned Lens的熵与散度特征同最终状态探针以及原始中间状态探针进行比较。在MATH-500上对八个指令微调模型的实验显示，原始中间状态能够改善正确性排序，而仅使用标量特征的探针通常落后于最终状态基线。标量混合方法虽存在积极的例外情况，但其相对于位置匹配置换对照的优势很小。基于交叉拟合的残差比较进一步表明，相对于最终状态探针的增益并不一定需要对齐的标量特征。在两种模型规模和两个基准上进行的实际停止实验揭示了一种独立的精度—计算权衡，其中token节省……（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现在生成中途弃答任务中，标量形式的Tuned Lens摘要特征（熵与散度）增量价值有限——原始中间状态探针能更好地改善正确性排序，而仅用标量的探针通常不敌最终状态基线。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that scalar Tuned Lens summary features offer limited incremental value for mid-generation abstention, as raw intermediate-state probes improve correctness ranking while scalar-only probes usually trail the final-state baseline.
